single_instructions.zh: 依據目前文字，專案現在最符合下列哪一種狀態？
single_instructions.en: Based on the current text, which project status is best supported?

paired_instructions.zh: 比較舊版本與新版本，專案狀態是否已改變？
paired_instructions.en: Comparing the old and new versions, has the project status changed?

en.A: Yes, the project status has changed.
en.B: No, the project status remains the same.

single_score: sum(normalized option probabilities B,C,D); missing any option => null; no zero imputation
paired_score: normalized option probability A; missing any option => null
prompt_source: jevlike.decide.prompt.TemplateRenderer and jevlike.decide.client.read_option_probs unchanged; no local template rewrite
benchmark: same frozen 100 new paragraphs; one untimed warmup per model; sequential batch=1, 4 CPU threads, no competing inference; C alt classification, D2 alt four hypotheses, J alt single
J_execution_order: e4b if local CPU resources permit
H8: E2B single all T6/T7 word and T8 sentence/paragraph paired-control AUROC >=0.85
H10: abs(J single - D2 alt single) <0.05 in all T6/T7 word and T8 sentence/paragraph contrasts; J weaker is reported as weaker, not stronger
H11: J single T10 concatenated new paragraphs AUROC >=0.80, exploratory synthetic policy only
missing_model_policy: unrun with concrete reason, never relabel another model
limitations: Same rules-only corpus and T10 constructed policy caveats as v0.2.
No Gemini generation or independent adjudication.
Q8 quantization, not full precision; input option mass and missing candidates retained.
Date-change pairs retain original status prose, so contradictory prose versus dates can affect semantic models.
cache_policy_note: Cost benchmark and its warmup use cache_prompt=false. Full J scoring uses the existing jevlike prefix cache for throughput; no label, question, or threshold changes. Frozen before any J scoring.
preflight_amendments: Before any J corpus scoring, two separate infrastructure fixtures showed the upstream default top-40 omitted option D in English. Increase existing reader n_probs to 256; both fixtures then returned all four options. No prompt, labels, examples, or hypothesis thresholds changed.
Full-scoring prefix cache enabled before J corpus scoring; same-fixture cached/uncached score differences recorded in infrastructure-smoke.json. Formal 100-row timing remains cache_prompt=false.
